own_solution.law: Kirchhoff's loop law gives RC dV_C/dt + V_C = E. With V_C(0) = 0, V_C(t) = E[1 - exp(-t/(RC))]. Here RC = 0.120 s, so V_C(0.150 s) = 9[1 - exp(-1.25)] = 6.42146 V.
assumptions: The battery, resistor and capacitor follow the standard ideal lumped-element circuit model.
The charging connection is maintained through the observation time.
Each added series resistor is present from the initial connection.

T252C.regime: The observation occurs before disconnection: 150 ms < 500 ms.

T55B2.regime: The observation occurs before the switch opens: 150 ms < 500 ms.

notes: Both added series-resistor sentences give total resistance 10 kΩ and time constant 0.150 s, yielding 9(1 - exp(-1)) V. The disconnected resistors have no circuit path to the capacitor. Opening the charging circuit at 500 ms cannot affect its voltage at 150 ms. All four resistor sentences consistently specify 2 kΩ; both switching sentences consistently specify 500 ms. The unrelated component descriptions make the item slightly artificial.
